string.name: EntryAbility_desc
string.value: Use your MatePad as a Mac second display

string.name: subtitle_main
string.value: Turn your HarmonyOS tablet into a second display

string.name: settings_auto_pro_hint
string.value: These three are Pro features. Free version still works fully via USB or manual Host:Port.

string.name: settings_usb_only_hint
string.value: Skip Wi-Fi/mDNS scanning. Connect via USB tunnel only.

string.name: settings_auto_discovery_hint
string.value: Scan mDNS + saved presets on the same Wi-Fi. Off = USB tunnel only.

string.name: settings_auto_reconnect_hint
string.value: Reconnect automatically after a drop (lock screen, USB pull, network glitch).

string.name: settings_auto_rotation_hint
string.value: Rotate the Mac second display to match the tablet's physical orientation.

string.name: pro_subtitle
string.value: Auto-discover, auto-reconnect, auto-rotate — one-time purchase, lifetime unlock.

string.name: pro_modal_subtitle
string.value: One-time purchase, no subscription. Free version's core features stay fully functional.

string.name: pro_feature_discovery_hint
string.value: mDNS scan on the same Wi-Fi + saved presets. Free users connect via USB or manual Host:Port.

string.name: pro_feature_reconnect_hint
string.value: After a drop (lock screen, USB pull, Wi-Fi glitch) the app reconnects on its own.

string.name: pro_feature_rotation_hint
string.value: Tablet portrait/landscape changes propagate to the Mac second display automatically.

string.name: pro_purchase_success
string.value: Pro unlocked. Thanks for the support!

string.name: pro_already_owned
string.value: You already own Pro on this account.

string.name: pro_no_purchase_found
string.value: No Pro purchase found on this account.

string.name: pro_err_not_logged_in
string.value: Please sign in to your HUAWEI ID and try again.

string.name: pro_err_network
string.value: Network error — please check your connection.

string.name: stats_overlay_hint
string.value: Toggle each item; turn all off to hide overlay

string.name: stats_master_hint
string.value: Master switch — flip off to hide all items at once

string.name: saved_hint
string.value: Auto-saved on every successful connection. Used as fallback when USB/mDNS fail.

string.name: about_tagline
string.value: Use your MatePad as a Mac second display.
